tasks.label: build SFML (Debug)
args: call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul && cl /nologo /EHsc /std:c++17 /MDd /Zi /Od /IC:\SFML-2.6.2\include "${workspaceFolder}\src\main.cpp" /Fe:"${workspaceFolder}\build e obj\main.exe" /Fo:"${workspaceFolder}\build e obj\main.obj" /Fd:"${workspaceFolder}\build e obj\main.pdb" /link /DEBUG /LIBPATH:C:\SFML-2.6.2\lib sfml-graphics-d.lib sfml-window-d.lib sfml-audio-d.lib sfml-network-d.lib sfml-system-d.lib
